summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted due to partial dislodgement of his left subclavian tunneled hemodialysis catheter, occurring during agitation at daycare. Given his history of difficult vascular access and prior MRSA line infections, interventional radiology successfully replaced the dialysis line under MAC anesthesia, using a left midline catheter for procedural access. The new line was placed without complications and confirmed functional. He underwent dialysis with removal of 3 liters of fluid, improving volume overload. Pressure ulcers were noted at the left gluteal fold, and the patient was counseled on repositioning and wound care. All home medications were continued without change. He was discharged home with services, advised to resume regular dialysis, monitor daily weight, and follow up with outpatient support for visit compliance.
